newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish end-Nov Exchequer Returns 153 million punt surplus. [CORRECTED 17:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Irish end-Nov Exchequer Returns 153 million punt surplus. [CORRECTED 17:35 GMT]

text.p: Ireland's end-November Exchequer Returns showed a 153 million punt surplus compared with a cumulative exchequer borrowing requirement of 504 million punts for the same period last year, the Department of Finance said on Tuesday (corrects to show 153 million punts figure not the borrowing requirement figure)
Total tax receipts came to 11.60 billion punts compared to 10.42 billion in the same period the previous year.
Miscellaneous revenue totalled 378.77 million punts while other receipts came to 330.84 million punts.
Central fund issues were 2.74 billion punts and supply services came to 9.63 billion punts, a statement by the Department said.
Other issues were 31.34 million punts compared to 83.13 million for the same period in 1995.
